focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征惩罚性关税，中国车企面临出口合规新挑战
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于6月30日公布临时反补贴调查结果，计划对进口自中国的纯电动汽车加征17%至36%的额外关税。此举将显著抬高中国车企出口欧洲的成本，影响比亚迪、上汽等企业的市场布局。建议企业提前调整供应链，评估原产地规则并考虑在欧盟境内设厂以规避风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会官方公报 · 2026.07.01
focus.title_en: EU Plans Punitive Tariffs on Chinese EVs, New Compliance Challenges for Exporters
focus.summary_en: On June 30, the European Commission released preliminary anti-subsidy findings, proposing additional tariffs of 17% to 36% on battery electric vehicles imported from China. This will significantly raise export costs for Chinese automakers like BYD and SAIC, impacting their market strategies. Companies are advised to adjust supply chains, assess rules of origin, and consider EU-based production to mitigate risks.
focus.source_en: Source: Official Journal of the European Union · 2026.07.01

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁定：跨境投资中“最惠国待遇”条款不自动适用于争议解决
case.summary: 在2026年6月的一起涉中资企业与东南亚国家的投资仲裁案中，SIAC仲裁庭明确：双边投资协定中的最惠国待遇条款原则上不延及争议解决程序，除非协定另有明确约定。该裁决提示中国投资者在谈判投资协定时需单独约定争端解决条款，避免依赖MFN条款自动获取更优程序权利。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心 · 2026年6月裁决
case.title_en: SIAC Rules: MFN Clause in BIT Does Not Automatically Extend to Dispute Resolution
case.summary_en: In a June 2026 investment arbitration involving a Chinese enterprise and a Southeast Asian state, the SIAC tribunal held that the most-favored-nation clause in a bilateral investment treaty does not, in principle, apply to dispute resolution procedures unless explicitly stated. The ruling advises Chinese investors to separately negotiate dispute resolution clauses in investment treaties, rather than relying on MFN treatment for procedural advantages.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre · June 2026 Award

policy.title: 深圳前海发布跨境数据流动“白名单”管理细则，简化企业数据出境合规流程
policy.summary: 深圳市前海管理局于6月30日发布《前海深港现代服务业合作区跨境数据流动“白名单”管理试行办法》，对经认定的企业，在跨境支付、供应链管理、国际营销等场景下的数据出境实施简化程序，免于逐次安全评估。企业需建立内部数据分类分级制度并申请纳入白名单，有效期两年。
policy.source: 来源：深圳市前海管理局 · 2026.06.30
policy.title_en: Qianhai Issues Whitelist Rules for Cross-Border Data Flow, Streamlining Compliance for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: On June 30, the Shenzhen Qianhai Authority released the 'Pilot Measures for the Management of Cross-Border Data Flow Whitelist in Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone.' Certified enterprises will enjoy simplified procedures for data export in scenarios like cross-border payments, supply chain management, and international marketing, exempting them from case-by-case security assessments. Companies must establish internal data classification systems and apply for whitelist status, valid for two years.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对俄次级制裁风险扩大，中国企业应审查涉俄交易链条
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期美国财政部OFAC加大对“涉俄”第三国企业的次级制裁执行力度，尤其关注电子元器件、机床、润滑油等转口贸易。建议中国企业立即审查客户与供应链中是否存在涉及俄罗斯受制裁实体或个人，避免因间接交易触发制裁风险。建立内部制裁筛查清单，对高敏感产品实施逐单合规审查。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部外国资产控制办公室（OFAC）近期执法趋势 · 2026.07.01
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Expanding US Secondary Sanctions on Russia – Chinese Enterprises Must Scrutinize Transaction Chains
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury OFAC has intensified enforcement of secondary sanctions against third-country firms linked to Russia, particularly targeting transshipment of electronic components, machine tools, and lubricants. Chinese enterprises are advised to immediately review customer and supply chains for any connection to sanctioned Russian entities or individuals, to avoid triggering sanctions through indirect transactions. Establish internal sanctions screening lists and conduct compliance reviews for high-risk products on a per-transaction basis.
analysis.source_en: Source: Recent enforcement trends of the US Treasury OFAC · 2026.07.01
